name: Dipl.-Ing. Michael Schiffer, MBA
headline: Process Optimization • Program Management • Generative AI • Healthcare Automation
oneLiner: Process optimizer & Program Manager with 20+ years in automotive industry, production launches and global plant structures. Since 2024 increasingly focused on Generative AI, Healthcare Automation, data analysis, AI-driven process optimization and telemedicine workflows. Operates a self-hosted on-premise LLM infrastructure on a heterogeneous multi-GPU cluster: two production RAG systems with around 42,000 embedded chunks (COBOL legacy corpus and a document/mail knowledge base), 130,000+ routed requests and 463M processed input tokens in 14 days. Solid expertise in Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, hybrid retrieval and reranking, GPU load management and document AI (OCR/vision LLM).

projects.title: RAG Knowledge Platform for Legacy COBOL Systems — Lead Architect

projects.title: E-Mail Automation and Archive with RAG Assistant

projects.title: Agent Studio — Multi-Agent Software Development with Claude Code
projects.description: Built and operate a development environment in which around two dozen Claude Code sessions work in parallel across several machines, each with its own workspace and identity. Coordination via a purpose-built ticket board on PostgreSQL: priorities, due dates, responsibility as a dedicated field, blocking, conditional claim; agents commission and review each other through sub-tickets. Shift operation with a watcher, versioned documentation and playbooks from Git, credentials exclusively via a broker. Codex as an independent reviewer.

projects.title: Agent Studio Overview — Control Station for Parallel Claude Code and Codex Sessions
projects.description: Control station for running many Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions at once: nine windows with around fifty sessions, built with one click and laid out automatically per workplace. Simultaneous prompting of multiple sessions with measured input readiness, automated command sequences, detection and reporting of open agent questions. Around 6,400 lines of Python, standard library only, 20 tables, 249 regression tests; replaces 13 shell scripts, monitoring load cut from 200 % to 4 % CPU.

projects.title: Modernisation of an Excel VBA Planning Application with Claude Code — Migration to CSV, SQLite and HTML
projects.description: AI-assisted reverse engineering and replacement of an 18-month project plan in Excel with around a dozen VBA macros for timeline, bars and predecessor arrows (around 130 work packages in 12 phases), implemented with Claude Code and reviewed with Codex. Key finding: Excel was carrying two roles at once — data storage and rendering. New architecture: CSV as source of truth, generated SQLite, static single-file HTML — 2,733 lines of Python and HTML/JS with no external dependencies, all four predecessor types (FS, SS, FF, SF), automated consistency check. Two silent error classes of the legacy system eliminated by construction.

projects.title: Agentic Coding with Local Open-Weight Models — Claude Code On-Premise
projects.description: Operate Claude Code additionally against locally hosted open-weight models (Qwen on llama.cpp) through a translator between the Anthropic and OpenAI interfaces — agentic coding without a cloud connection. Found and fixed two different causes behind the same grammar-enforcement error message; production run with 40 tools and around 87,000 tokens. Model choice by measurement: 144 agent runs with hidden checks — Qwen3.8-27B solves 72 of 72, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 64 of 72; routing by task derived from it.
